changelog:
- Replaces Python-based MCP client with a Node.js script (`scripts/mcp-call.js`) for spawning and interacting with MCP servers via JSON-RPC stdio.
- Now reads MCP server configuration from user’s OpenClaw config (supports both JSON and YAML formats).
- Removes previous Python library and documentation (`mcp_client.py`, `skill-card.md`); all workflow details moved to updated `SKILL.md`.
- Details a new workflow for discovering, launching, and communicating with any locally configured MCP server instance.
- Adds comprehensive documentation on intended use cases, security considerations, helper script commands, and server tool reference.
- Informs users this skill is for OpenClaw versions lacking native MCP client support and will be obsolete once native support is available.
